hook_text: Read this if you feel like giving up
subtext: You are closer to the harvest than you think.
verse_text: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
reflection: Paul wrote this to people who were exhausted from doing the right thing without seeing results. The Greek word for 'weary' means to lose heart from prolonged effort. God sees every unseen sacrifice. Your faithfulness is not wasted—it is stored up for the proper time.
cta: Don't give up. Journal through it with SOAPaDay.
caption:
Some seasons feel endless. You show up, you serve, you pray—and nothing seems to change.

But Galatians 6:9 was written for exactly this moment.

The harvest is coming. Not on your timeline, but on His. And it will be worth every step.

What's one area where you need to keep going today? Drop it below. 👇
